timeline.text: Hi! How can I help you today?
timeline.zh: 嗨！今天我能帮您什么忙？

timeline.text: Hey, hi, I'm contacting you about an order I placed. I've got a bit of a situation with one of the items.
timeline.zh: 嘿，你好，我联系你是因为我下了一个订单。其中一个商品出了点问题。

timeline.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you with your order situation. To get started, I'll need to authenticate your identity first. 

Could you please provide your email address associated with your account?
timeline.zh:
你好！我很乐意帮助您解决订单问题。首先，我需要验证您的身份。

您能提供与您的账户关联的电子邮件地址吗？

timeline.text: Hmm, yeah, I don't think that's gonna work for me. I don't remember my email address right now.
timeline.zh: 嗯，不，那对我可能不太行。我现在记不起我的电子邮件地址了。

timeline.text:
No problem! I can help you authenticate using your name and zip code instead. 

Could you please provide:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

This will help me locate your account.
timeline.zh:
没问题！我可以帮助您使用您的姓名和邮政编码进行身份验证。

您能提供以下信息吗：
- 您的名字
- 您的姓氏  
- 您的邮政编码

这将帮助我找到您的账户。

timeline.text: Okay, sure. My name is Aarav Anderson, and my zip code is 19031.
timeline.zh: 好的，没问题。我的名字是Aarav Anderson，我的邮政编码是19031。

timeline.text:
Great! I found your account. Now I can help you with your order situation. 

Could you please provide your order ID? It should look like #W0000000 (starting with #W).
timeline.zh:
太好了！我找到了您的账户。现在我可以帮助您解决订单问题。

您能提供您的订单号吗？它应该看起来像 #W0000000（以 #W 开头）。

timeline.text: Let me see here... I don't have the order ID right in front of me. Could you maybe send it to me?
timeline.zh: 让我看看……我手头没有订单号。您能发给我吗？

timeline.text: I can help you look up your recent orders! Let me get your account details to see your order history.
timeline.zh: 我可以帮您查找您的最近订单！让我获取您的账户详细信息以查看您的订单历史。
